_meta.title: Acknowledgements Formats — output spec + build data
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable form of 00_Copyright_Acks_Formatting_Rules.md (§1–5 output formats, §6 build regexes/authority rules, §7 oEmbed, §8 ACK-TODO contract). AcksBuilder.js reads THIS file; no ack format lives in code. Templates use {placeholders} filled by the builder.
_meta.extension_rule: New entry type, new source provider, new standing text, new marker type = a data edit HERE, never a code change.
_meta.precedence: This file mirrors 00_Copyright_Acks_Formatting_Rules.md, which beats every older reference (v1 video format, Shutterstock long form, acksTemplate retirement claim are all superseded).
_meta.policy: The acknowledgements block is generated for EVERY module — always, no conditional logic (locked 2026-06-12). Placement: bottom of the very first page (-00 overview, or the only page of a single-file module), as div.acks AFTER (outside) the #footer div. Never on the last page.

container.wrapper_open: Acknowledgements
container.ai_variant_rule: Use the AI variant container when the module contains ANY AI-generated item (source classified 'ai').
container.wrapper_note: row > col-md-8 wrapper matches current corpus practice (e.g. OSAH401_0.0.html).

lesson_groups.group_label_note: The lesson-naming comment is part of the acks output spec (§1) — one of the sanctioned comment uses. Lesson ids use the page's decimal form, e.g. 'Lesson 1.0'.

journal.heading: Journal
journal.status: Supported in the output structure; AUTOMATIC grouping of journal items is deferred until the marking convention is confirmed with CS (Phase-1 scope). No journal group is auto-emitted.

standing_items.opening_disclaimer: Every effort has been made to acknowledge and contact copyright holders. Te Aho o Te Kura Pounamu apologises for any omissions and welcomes more accurate information.
standing_items.ai_usage_statement: Parts of this resource were created with assistance from AI tools. For more information on the extent and nature of this AI usage, please contact Te Aho o Te Kura Pounamu.
standing_items.ai_usage_rule: Emit directly underneath the opening disclaimer when the module contains AI-assisted content (any item classified 'ai').
standing_items.catch_all: All other images © Te Aho o Te Kura Pounamu, Wellington, New Zealand.
standing_items.catch_all_note: When Te Kura-produced video/audio is also present the human form expands ('All other images and audio …'); the converter cannot reliably know that, so it emits the base line — a developer adjusts if needed.

standing_items.year_rule: The year is NEVER hard-coded — the empty renders it.

template_variant_omit.rule: ROUND 241 (Dev-Feedback R4, E3 — SCCH302's doubled acknowledgements boilerplate). When the block ships the TEMPLATE container class (the AI variant 'acks acksTemplate acksAI'), the site's own stylesheet/template INJECTS the standing boilerplate — so emitting the three paragraphs too makes them appear TWICE on the published page. MEASURED (round 241, every gold acks block): pages carrying the exact triple class omit all three 24/27; 'acks acksTemplate' 20/28; the plain 'acks' class KEEPS them 415/416 (unchanged here). The listed standing items are therefore OMITTED when (and only when) the template/AI container class is emitted; the catch_all line is KEPT (43/55 template-class golds ship it); an opening group left EMPTY by the omission (no unverified-iStock note to carry) is dropped whole — the gold form shows no empty acksLesson div. The 3 gold triple-class keepers (ENGJ403/BLL275/SSOG105) are the minority form, never chased. Env ACKSBOILER_OFF reverts to emitting all three paragraphs regardless of class.

hyperlink_rule.anchor_text: the full URL itself — never descriptive text
hyperlink_rule.note: Comma + space precedes the link; the full stop sits OUTSIDE . iStock/Getty entries are plain text only.

type_prefix_map._fallback_rule: Unknown item type → Title Case the writer's own word as the prefix AND record a red-flag note in the summary (never silently absorb).

source_classification.rule: Classify each media item by first matching the URL domain, then the Source column keywords, then type keywords. First hit wins.
source_classification.tekura_rule: Items classified 'tekura' are covered by the standing catch-all line — no individual entry is emitted.
source_classification.non_media_skip: Item types in skip_types are lesson links, not acknowledgeable media — skip the entry, record a summary note (scope rule §1: external links used in lessons do not receive acknowledgements).

istock_slug_title.rule: The iStock URL slug IS the official asset title in kebab-case (98% verified on 1,388 pairs): split the slug on '-', Title Case each word, then apply special_tokens casing. Only a bare ID with no URL needs manual sourcing → ACK-TODO[istock-name].
istock_slug_title.special_tokens_note: Only unambiguous abbreviations belong here — 'it'/'id' were removed because they are ordinary words in titles ('It features…').
istock_slug_title.casing_note: Minor punctuation/case differences from the provider's exact casing are acceptable per the verified rule — human-written acks vary too.

istock_acks_file._note:
ROUND 235 (Chris) — the OPTIONAL verified iStock acknowledgements file (CL-0002 adopted into the input contract). A file named *_istock-acks.txt can be uploaded alongside the WT + Media List (or sit in the module folder for a batch run): one fully-formed ack per line, e.g.

Photo: Friends dancing in the street, iStock 1422643105, Getty Images. Used with permission.

, sourced from the iStock API via Getty — so its titles are DEFINITELY correct and OUTRANK the slug-derived title (title_authority for iStock becomes: API file > URL slug > ACK-TODO). The engine parses each line into id → {title, line} (line_pattern below: title = everything between the first ': ' and the LAST ', iStock ,' — titles may themselves contain commas); when #istockEntry knows the asset id and the map carries it, the VERIFIED title fills the normal entry template ({TypePrefix}/{Adapted} still composed per the item), which for a photo reproduces the file's own line exactly. Ids not in the file fall back to the slug rule / ACK-TODO unchanged. Env ISTOCKACKS_OFF (or enabled:false) ignores the file entirely.

detect._note: ROUND 236 (Chris) — CONTENT-FIRST recognition. Round 235 accepted the file only when its NAME ended 'istock-acks.txt', which breaks the moment the module code joins the filename (_istock-acks-OSAI501.txt / _OSAI501-istock-acks.txt) and cannot cope with the variants already in circulation. The file is now recognised by WHAT IT CONTAINS: any .txt whose lines are iStock acknowledgements (line_pattern above) and effectively nothing else. The filename is a SECONDARY safeguard only — 'istock' and/or 'acks' anywhere in it raises confidence and breaks ties between two qualifying files, but never gates acceptance. MEASURED SAFE on the corpus: all 559 .txt files sitting beside the module .docx inputs are '*_parsed.txt' WT dumps and ZERO of them contain a single matching line, so content-first detection cannot false-positive here; the generator's own {CODE}_interactives.txt hand-off is excluded by the same content test. Env ISTOCKDETECT_OFF reverts to the round-235 filename-only rule.
detect.share_note: min_share_of_nonempty guards the 'and nothing else' half of Chris's rule: a .txt that merely MENTIONS iStock in prose (a writer's note, a media list dump) fails it. min_matching_lines stops a one-line fragment qualifying. A file passing both is the acks file whatever it is called.

istock_unverified._note:
ROUND 236 (Chris) — SOURCING HONESTY for iStock TITLES. Without a verified acks file every iStock title is DERIVED from the URL slug (the round-235 istock_slug_title rule, 98% accurate but not confirmed) and the finished line reads exactly like a verified one, so the designer cannot tell which titles were checked against the iStock API and which were inferred. Per Chris: an unverified iStock acknowledgement carries a VISIBLE marker, and the page carries one red designer note explaining why. This is the ACK-TODO contract's third state — the line is COMPLETE (no bracketed slot) but UNCONFIRMED — so it deliberately does NOT take the ackTodo class: it stays a plain

exactly like the human's, gaining only the marker character. That keeps it invisible to the skeleton (text-stripped, class unchanged) and keeps its text in compare_structure's acks harvest, while still showing on the page. Ids the file DOES cover are untouched; entries already carrying a visible ❗ (istock-name / asset-id ACK-TODOs) are left alone — they are flagged already. Env ISTOCKUNVERIFIED_OFF.
istock_unverified.note_form: Designer/Developer To Do: {text}
istock_unverified.note_no_file: No iStock acknowledgements file (*istock-acks*.txt) was supplied with this module, so the {count} iStock title{plural} below could not be verified against the iStock API and {were} derived from the image URL. Each unverified line is marked ❗. Please supply the verified acknowledgements file, or confirm each title before publishing.
istock_unverified.note_partial: The supplied iStock acknowledgements file did not cover {count} of the iStock asset{plural} used in this module, so {those} title{plural} were derived from the image URL rather than verified against the iStock API. Each unverified line is marked ❗. Unverified asset id{plural}: {ids}.
istock_unverified.note_position: top of the acknowledgements block, inside the opening-disclaimer group — the designer reads it in context, immediately above the ❗ lines it refers to (Chris's decision 2026-07-29). Carries class cv2-note, so it is gate-excluded by construction like every other converter note (round 72).

title_authority.stock: Official asset name only — writer descriptions are NOT acceptable for stock assets (istock/other_stock/pixabay). Derive from the URL slug, or emit ACK-TODO[istock-name].
title_authority.youtube: oEmbed title/author verbatim (including any '| Site' suffix), or ACK-TODO[video-meta].
title_authority.website: The writer's description is the normal title source for non-stock web media — use it as {Title}.

oembed.retrieved_date_rule: Stamped by the program at fetch time — the converter's own run date.
oembed.failure_rule: Empty body or HTTP error → ACK-TODO[video-meta] with reason 'unavailable' | 'offline' | 'error'. Never fabricate fields. A fetch failure doubles as a dead-link signal worth surfacing.
oembed.cors_note: Verified 12/06/26: the endpoint echoes Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so in-browser fetch works.

ack_todo.policy: Every marker has a VISIBLE component. The HTML comment is a machine-readable supplement only — never the sole signal (v1 shipped missed comments to live modules).
ack_todo.flag_unknown_type_note: ROUND 87 (Chris, ENGI302-00): when an item's type is NOT in type_prefix_map, #typePrefix falls back to Title-casing the writer's own word ('jpg'→'Jpg', 'text'→'Text') and logs a SUMMARY note only — so the acks line ships with NO visible ❗, unlike the video-meta line beside it which DOES carry one. Per Chris: a line that cannot be confidently formatted 'due to not enough information' must carry the SAME ❗ as the other incomplete copyright lines. With this on, an unknown-type entry that built a plain line is re-emitted as a visible ❗ ackTodo (type 'unknown-type'), keeping its content but flagging it for CS; an entry that was ALREADY a TODO (e.g. asset-id) is untouched (it already shows ❗), and skip/tekura items are unaffected (they never produce a line). DATA-driven cure: ADD a recurring type to type_prefix_map (a data edit) and the flag disappears for it. Measured: jpg 97, pdf 70, text 36, mp3 20, webpage 27, doc 16, … (outputs/_measure_round87.py). Env ACKUNKNOWN_OFF reverts to the silent summary-only fallback. Gate-NEUTRAL: compare_structure counts ❗ ackTodo lines separately (never as acks content) and the skeleton skips acks; the human ships fully-resolved acks with no counterpart for these draft lines.
ack_todo.visible_form_designer: ❗ Confirm any media added during design for this lesson is acknowledged, then delete this line.

istock-name.when: iStock ID known, no URL to derive the title from, title not in writer docs

asset-id.when: title known, no ID/URL in writer docs

licence.when: CC item whose licence name is not in writer docs

unknown-type.when: item type not in type_prefix_map (round 87) — the built line cannot be confidently formatted; surfaced with the SAME ❗ as the other incomplete lines instead of a silent summary note

ack_todo.security: ACK-TODO comments carry only sourcing metadata — NEVER answer content (converter-wide rule).
ack_todo.build_gate: The conversion summary reports the per-module ACK-TODO count; acks are complete only at zero.
